parameters.help_en:
The line type. Valid values:

BGP (default): BGP (multi-ISP) line.

BGP_PRO: BGP (multi-ISP) Pro line.

For more information about BGP (multi-ISP) lines and BGP (multi-ISP) Pro lines, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/32321.html.

If you are a whitelist user of single-ISP bandwidth, you can also select the following types:
ChinaTelecom: China Telecom
ChinaUnicom: China Unicom
ChinaMobile: China Mobile
ChinaTelecom_L2: China Telecom L2
ChinaUnicom_L2: China Unicom L2
ChinaMobile_L2: China Mobile L2

If you are a China (Hangzhou) Finance Cloud user, this field is required. Set the value to BGP_FinanceCloud
parameters.help_zh:
线路类型。取值：

BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路。

BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）_精品线路。

关于BGP（多线）线路和BGP（多线）_精品线路的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/32321.html。

如果您是单线带宽的白名单用户，您还可以选择以下类型：
ChinaTelecom：中国电信
ChinaUnicom：中国联通
ChinaMobile：中国移动
ChinaTelecom_L2：中国电信L2
ChinaUnicom_L2：中国联通L2
ChinaMobile_L2：中国移动L2

如果您是杭州金融云用户，该字段必填，取值：BGP_FinanceCloud
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en:
The name of the IP address pool instance.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
地址池实例的名称。

名称长度为0-128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without querying available IP address pool information. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business restrictions are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会查询可使用的IP地址池信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the IP address pool belongs
